SELECT
T2.INT_TYPE, T3.BASIS, T2.RATE*100 RATE,
T2.HIGHEST_RATE*100 as HIGHEST_RATE, T2.LOWEST_RATE*100 LOWEST_RATE, T2.BENCHMARK_ID, T2.BENCHMARK_TYPE, T2.COEFFICIENT, T2.SPREAD_RATE*100 SPREAD_RATE, T2.RESET_TYPE, T2.OBSERVE_BEF_DAY, T2.OBSERVE_BEF_UNIT, T6.INVEST_RATE * 100 INVEST_RATE, T6.LOAD_RATE*100 LOAD_RATE, T5.COUPON_SPECIES, T5.FINPROD_TYPE2, case when T2.RATE != T6.INVEST_RATE then '01' else '02' end calRateType FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO T2 ON T2.CASH_ID = T1.CASH_ID
AND T2.EFF_DATE = STR_TO_DATE ( #{vdate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T3 ON T3.CASH_ID = T1.CASH_ID
AND T3.EFF_DATE = STR_TO_DATE ( #{vdate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T4 on T4.CASH_ID = T1.CASH_ID
AND T4.EFF_DATE = STR_TO_DATE ( #{vdate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T6 on T6.CASH_ID = T1.CASH_ID
AND T6.EFF_DATE = STR_TO_DATE ( #{vdate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 on T5.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID
AND T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND T1.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
